about: The demo Q&A evaluation set (docs/demo). Written and committed before the index was built; the index and the scorer must not be tuned on it. 'answerable': expected is a list of acceptable sources, a hit when any is retrieved. 'two_source': two groups, a top-3 hit only when both groups appear in the top 3, a top-1 hit when the first passage is in either group. 'uncovered': the project does not cover it; correct when the page declines (no passage above the threshold). A transcript source is transcript:scene-N; its timestamp is the start of the matching transcript segment, read from transcript.json after recording. A doc source is path#section heading.
